statusDefinitions.unresolved: Parity is not yet proven. This remains a final-pass blocker.

deviations.source: The source foreground resolver and variant tone tables can use light ink for semantic success or danger solid fills.
deviations.port: Resax uses invariant rgb(var(--rx-fixed-dark)) ink for success, danger, and warn solid fills while preserving the source variant geometry and choreography.
deviations.reason: First-paint Axe evidence proves the light-ink pairs fail the project-required 4.5:1 contrast threshold with the Resax semantic palette.

deviations.source: The source primary hover fades the complete button to opacity .85.
deviations.port: Resax applies the source-derived --rx-color-hover background while leaving foreground opacity unchanged.
deviations.reason: Fading the whole element reduces text contrast; the background-only treatment retains the source hover change without weakening the foreground.

deviations.source: The source secondary and ghost surfaces are tuned for its dark-first palette and use its fixed text colors.
deviations.port: The compatible flat, border, and transparent axes use a contrast-safe accent/text mix in light mode and retain the source-like foreground in dark mode.
deviations.reason: The consolidated Resax API supports both themes, and the source fixed-light treatment does not remain legible on light surfaces.

deviations.source: The source defines a reduced-motion branch but no separate coarse-pointer policy.
deviations.port: On coarse pointers Resax disables pointer-following item transforms, glass tilt, sheen, and pointer halo while retaining passive Aurora, Neon, and press animations; reduced motion disables all motion separately.
deviations.reason: Touch input has no continuous hover coordinates, and the Phase 4c accessibility contract requires static pointer geometry without treating touch as a reduced-motion preference.
